summary: three.js r187 场景的材质与光照：标准、物理和无光照材质、灯光、阴影、HDR 环境光和色调映射。 Lights and shades three.js r187 scenes: standard, physical and unlit materials, lights, shadows, HDR environment lighting and tone mapping. Use when a mesh renders black or washed out, shadows are missing or full of acne, or EffectComposer darkens the image. Not for renderer setup (`threejs-scene-setup`), model loading (`threejs-gltf-loading`) or custom shaders (`shader-programming`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill threejs-materials-lighting，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use when a mesh renders black or washed out, shadows are missing or full of acne, or EffectComposer darkens the image.
Workflow: Rule out geometry first; Default to `MeshStandardMaterial`; Light the scene; Turn on shadows in three places.

需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：threejs-scene-setup 用 gene_gdsk_threejs_scene_setup_v1，threejs-gltf-loading 用 gene_gdsk_threejs_gltf_loading_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
